title: Mask Adoption Behavioral Diffusion Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior spreads and persists in a population under peer influence, information campaigns, and policy mandates, optionally coupled to disease risk.

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: People observe peers' mask-wearing and update their probability of wearing a mask via social conformity and influence susceptibility.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Mandates and enforcement at venues or jurisdiction increase compliance probability and may impose penalties for non-compliance.

interactions.name: information_dissemination
interactions.description: Authority and other information sources broadcast messages that affect risk perception, trust, and mask adoption.

interactions.name: venue_interaction
interactions.description: People meet at venues; interactions lead to observation of norms, potential enforcement, and optional disease transmission.

interactions.name: mask_acquisition
interactions.description: People acquire masks depending on access and availability; lack of access raises perceived cost and reduces adoption.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Fraction of people wearing masks at each time step.

metrics.name: peak_adoption
metrics.description: Maximum mask adoption rate observed during the simulation.

metrics.name: time_to_50_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days until the population reaches 50% mask adoption.

metrics.name: compliance_duration_mean
metrics.description: Average consecutive days an adopter continues to wear a mask.

metrics.name: policy_effect_uplift
metrics.description: Increase in adoption attributable to policy/enforcement relative to a no-policy baseline.

metrics.name: campaign_effect_uplift
metrics.description: Increase in adoption attributable to information campaigns relative to a no-campaign baseline.

metrics.name: adoption_inequality_index
metrics.description: Inequality of adoption across subgroups (e.g., age or trust quantiles), e.g., Gini or variance.

metrics.name: venue_compliance_rate
metrics.description: Share of masked individuals within each venue type over time.

metrics.name: dropout_rate
metrics.description: Rate at which previously masked individuals stop masking per time step.

metrics.name: net_social_influence_R
metrics.description: Average number of additional adopters directly influenced by a single adopter (behavioral reproduction number).

metrics.name: infection_prevalence_over_time
metrics.description: Optional if disease is modeled: share of population infected each day.

validation_criteria.name: adoption_convergence
validation_criteria.description: Adoption rate change is below a small threshold (e.g., <0.5 percentage points) for a set number of consecutive days.

validation_criteria.name: stability_under_reseeding
validation_criteria.description: Key metrics (e.g., peak_adoption, t50) remain within a tolerance across multiple random seeds.
